entries.title: Speaking at LEAP East 2026, Hong Kong
entries.excerpt: Founder Kenneth Kwong joined a panel on entrepreneurship, investing, and venture capital at LEAP East, held at HKCEC on 8–10 July 2026.

entries.title: Leading a Hong Kong delegation across the Greater Bay Area
entries.excerpt: DF Group led a Hong Kong delegation to Shenzhen and joined the China Greater Bay Area Industry & Capital Investment Conference, deepening ties across Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Chongqing.

entries.title: In France & Monaco: wealth legacy and the Blue Economy & Finance Forum
entries.excerpt: Kenneth Kwong met leading European business families and, invited by the Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco, attended the Blue Economy & Finance Forum on ocean science and impact investing.

entries.title: Convening founders with the INSEAD Alumni Entrepreneurship Club, Singapore
entries.excerpt: A series of Singapore events bringing tier-one investors, operators, and founders together across AI, quantum, medtech, climate, fintech, and advanced manufacturing.

entries.title: Supporting TEDxHongKong 2026
entries.excerpt: DF Group is proud to be an ecosystem supporter of TEDxHongKong, held at Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks (HKSTP).

entries.title: Sustainable Finance Initiative & La French Tech
entries.excerpt: As an SFi member, DF Group joined the Sustainable Finance Initiative Summit, and served as community partner for La French Tech’s “French Tech After Hours: AI in Finance & Trading.”
